witness.name: CPI futures reaction and saved first-hour path follow-up
witness.opening_message: When CPI surprises, how hard do bonds and stocks move in the next hour, did that change during the 2021 to 2023 inflation surge, and is it still true today?
recorded_choices: U.S. headline CPI, month over month
witness.follow_up: Explain how stocks and Treasury futures moved through the first hour after CPI releases in each period, using the saved study’s path results and noting the available coverage.
witness.original_outcome: First attempt failed loading the ZB daily contract schedule. Recovery changed ZB to nearest-expiry and completed; the saved-path follow-up then had no declared input tables and did not inspect five-minute path values.
witness.registration: Regression witness for future RE03/RE07 campaigns; frozen historical catalogues and grades stay unchanged.

data_contract: Preserve all five selected markets, period and release/price clocks.
Keep one authoritative row per daily continuation timestamp; reject genuine conflicting source records without an authorized resolution rule.
Prove the failure cause with raw source/cache evidence before changing loader behavior.
Do not silently change the ZB roll methodology to obtain success.
saved_path_contract: The primary Chat study publishes its requested dashboard.
Retain only explicitly declared, meaningful result relations needed for subsequent analysis; no raw grid or private chart-backing escape.
Follow-up reads the same pinned saved path and coverage inputs, reports actual five-minute movement and coverage, and causes zero primary-study reruns or source reacquisitions.
An existing study with no eligible saved inputs yields a precise limitation, not an invented path or a summary presented as path analysis.
evidence: Original source and exact revision/IDs, raw failures, repaired source diff and effective acquisition window.
Actual LOCAL original/repaired execution receipts; separate captured-source replay from fresh agent authoring.
Full saved-input catalogue and relevant Arrow rows, numerical path oracle, follow-up transcript and native execution/admission counts.
Measured coverage for all three eras, direction groups and all five markets; source gaps remain explicit.
evidence_quality: Reconcile all eligible releases and every exclusion by market, exact clock and contract continuity; audit delivery-month concentration.
Keep mean absolute move, signed group means and surprise-regression slope distinct in the summary.
Show sample size and distribution sensitivity; leave-one-out and core-CPI analyses remain labelled alternatives.
Current-calendar actuals/consensus do not establish original first-print vintages.
External paper/duration comparisons require their actual source and explicit assumptions.

execution_policy.initial_capture_replay: Use exact recorded source and choices. Label diagnostic minimizations separately.
execution_policy.fresh_conversation: Ask the opening naturally; apply recorded answers only to matching actual clarification questions. Stop for a genuinely new user choice.

owner_reported_leads.verification: Reported numbers preserved below. See separate verified baseline; these are not target values for a repaired cohort.

verified_baseline.scope: The current LOCAL calendar agrees with all81 saved event timestamps and actual/consensus values; it does not establish the original DEV source snapshot or first-print vintages.
verified_baseline.narrative: Mean absolute moves fall after the surge for allfour Treasury futures. Sensitivity magnitudes rise forZT,ZN,ZB andfall forZF; these are differentmetrics.
